detail: Full summary: memsearch has an open security issue (#594): config trust-boundary — malicious project-local .memsearch.toml can redirect embedding base_url to exfiltrate API keys during auto-index at session start. Relevant if anyone proposes running both tools side by side. Twining's own unexamined surfaces per the fairness critic: dashboard on port 24282 (auth/binding), shell hooks executing on every commit/stop.
